title: nf-core/ebbf pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

zarr_dir.errorMessage: Path to SpatialData zarr directory must be provided

model_weights.errorMessage: Optional path to a pre-trained .pt checkpoint. When set, training is skipped for this sample and these weights are used directly for inference.

preprocess_dir.errorMessage: Optional directory holding an existing stdata.npz and transcripts.parquet for this sample. When set, preprocessing is skipped and those files are reused.

inference_results.errorMessage: Optional directory of part-*.parquet inference shards for this sample (either directly, or under a <sample-id>/ subdirectory). When set, training and inference are skipped and these shards feed postprocessing.
